Pfusion.definition: 总聚变功率目标，非计算输出

duration.definition: 目标持续运行时间，非能量约束时间

hardConstraints.definition: Required launched RF cap; no wallplug efficiency
ITER q-star screening proxy, not MHD stability
Toroidal beta screening bound; not validated MHD limit

assumptions: 50 radial nodes; PRF normalized fits; approximate volume Jacobian
Radas coronal intrinsic impurities; no seeding feedback
H98 total loss definition with volume mean substituted for line mean by explicit model selection
DT full alpha deposition; no particle balance
No core-radiation or auxiliary-power clipping is accepted as a steady-state solution
Homothetic analytic D-shaped surfaces, no GS equilibrium; geometry is not SPARC engineering data
PRF shape using Angioni input-state peaking (mean-product beta); no pressure/peaking iteration
PRF normalized explicitly to input volume means over full radius; fuel follows ne by pointwise quasineutrality
Constant impurity n_j/ne and coronal mean charge evaluated at input ne,Te; T_D=T_T=T_imp=Ti
Zeff uses Zbar squared, not charge-state second moments; radial ionization balance not solved
Radiation uses local PRF ne,Te coronal Lz; synchrotron/ohmic/bootstrap remain upstream approximations
q-star uses homothetic shape delta on every surface, not an inferred magnetic flux surface q95
DT full alpha deposition; steady core boundary, SOL radiation outside that boundary not evaluated
All thermal, radiation and fusion integrals use the same volume coordinate and trapezoid rule
densityForScalings selects H98, Greenwald and Martin/Ryter density together; volume_proxy is explicitly empirical
Transport-power H98 is a declared convention sensitivity, not a reconstructed V2 baseline

P_SOL_MW.definition: P_in - core radiation

P_in_MW.definition: Analytic H98 inversion: (W/C)^(1/0.31); total heating/loss including core radiation

W_thermal_MJ.definition: 1.5 V [<ne><Te>+(<nDT>+sum<nimp>)<Ti>]; product of means, not integral nT

tau_E_s.definition: W/P_in; H98 uses explicitly acknowledged volume-density proxy for line density

P_SOL_over_P_LH.definition: Net separatrix transport power / LH threshold

q_star_ITER.definition: ITER aspect-ratio/shaping corrected q-star proxy; not q95 equilibrium

plasma_volume_m3.definition: 2 pi R0^3 epsilon^2 kappaA [pi-(pi-8/3)epsilon]; analytic delta=1 approximation

beta_toroidal.definition: Toroidal thermal pressure to magnetic pressure ratio, products of means
